facts.note: Transcript states Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy after dinner, and that when the temple struck ten his watch showed four minutes to ten.

Transcript states he went out into the street at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house. The reason (wanting air and a cigar) is an addition that restates the sheet's purpose of smoking and adds no new time or place.
Transcript states the piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch, and stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
Transcript states that at twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.

Transcript states he came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch, that the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven, and that he went up to Félix in the library.
